mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit platelet aggregation and increase bleeding risk; phenelzine is an MAOI that may potentiate hypertensive response and NSAIDs can reduce antihypertensive control while increasing GI bleeding risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use alternative analgesic (acetaminophen preferred); if NSAID necessary, use lowest dose for shortest duration with gastroprotection and close monitoring for hypertensive episodes and bleeding.
